name: @red-cup-engineering/card-table
description: The house's shared playing-card engine: the card model, deterministic FNV-1a + mulberry32 seeded shuffle, N-deck/N-suit deck builder, draw/deal helpers, and a multi-deck dealing shoe with cut-card penetration (deck, shoe); procedural, zero-DOM inline-SVG card faces/backs/chips themed via CSS custom properties (svg); an exact 5-card and best-5-of-7 poker hand evaluator with tiebreak-correct total ordering (evaluate); and blackjack hand-total math, H17/S17 dealer policy, and exact per-decision (stand/hit/double/split) EV by recursive shoe-composition enumeration (blackjack). deck/svg are extracted from solitaire-service's cards.mts/cards-svg.mjs (see README, "Provenance"); evaluate/blackjack close the confirmed casino-math gap for poker and blackjack, in the exact-enumeration style parlor-kernel/odds.mjs established. Depends on computer-data randomization for its FNV-1a/mulberry32 seeded shuffle.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
